findings.detail: E01 compared holdings fair value of 184.466 million to balance-sheet total assets of 254.797 million instead of the filing's Total Investments fair-value total of 184.466 million.

rationale: Raw source shows the current-period Schedule of Investments total fair value is 184.466 million, matching the extracted holdings_fv of 184.466 million. A fair-value hierarchy table independently repeats Total Investments at 184.466 million. The 254.797 million comparison value is the balance-sheet Total assets line, not an investments fair-value anchor, so the E01 failure is a false alarm caused by a bad anchor.
